avoidWhen.text: Avoid showing confidence numbers when the person cannot act on them or choose another option.

customize.text: Choose how strongly to emphasize the primary recommendation and whether to display numeric confidence beside each option.

keep.text: Exposes an accessible region naming the primary recommendation and its alternatives.
Each offered alternative is reachable and selectable through a named operable control.
Fits a narrow viewport without horizontal overflow.
Confidence expresses certainty only; whether an action applies automatically depends on reversibility, not a confidence threshold.

default.text: Mount a result with confidence and alternatives from spec/wire/result-success-full.json, showing the primary option and an operable alternative control.

summary: Present a primary result alongside selectable alternatives and calibrated certainty without tying auto-apply to confidence.

useWhen.text: Use when a command returns alternatives or a confidence score the person can review and act on.
